transcript.text: Good morning, everyone. I've been asked to restore a worn 1920s community cookbook. The cover is detached and several pages are loose. Before I decide whether to accept this commission, I'd like to hear from each of you regarding any terms, offers, or material constraints I should be aware of. Please go ahead.
